title: Study of Vibration Damping in Composite Bars with a Dammar-Based Hybrid Matrix and Natural Fabric Reinforcements
content: Using a parameter that characterizes the damping capacity of the bar material, a mathematical model was developed to control the transverse vibration motion of a slender bar under boundary conditions defined by various support configurations. The model was validated for composite bars reinforced with natural fabrics made of flax, cotton, silk, or hemp fibers, and a hybrid resin matrix containing a 60% volumetric fraction of natural Dammar resin.
